messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill

Your order shows as delivered. The Nexus S1 on Shop···· left our Rotterdam warehouse on November 12, and the carrier marked it delivered in (address hidden) today, November 18.

You can check the tracking here: (tracking link hidden)

If it isn't at your door or with a neighbour, tell me and I'll look into it.
Hi no I've received it but its the wrong model. You've sent me a Nexus L1 rather than an Nexus S1
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Handed to the team · Wrong model shipped; replacement and return of the L1 need a person to set up.

I'm sorry about that. You paid for a Nexus S1 on Shop····, and getting an L1 in the box is our mistake, not yours.

I've passed it to the team so they can sort out getting the right S1 to you and what happens with the L1. Someone will pick up your ticket and email you at (email hidden)

Can you reply here with a photo of the unit and one of the label on the box? That will help them confirm the mix-up quickly. Please keep the L1 unplugged and in its packaging for now.
I've plugged it in and its running. It was the only way I found out

That makes sense, and it's no problem. Plugging it in is how most people would spot it.

A screenshot of the dashboard showing the model and hashrate would be just as useful as a photo, along with one of the box label. Since it isn't the unit you ordered, it's best to power it down and repack it once you've taken those.

The team already has your ticket, and someone will get back to you by email with how they'll get your S1 to you.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
Used the store-orders skill

Thanks, that settles it. The board is printed "Model: L1", and it's running at 320.9 MH/s on a BM1491 chip. That's a Nexus L1, which mines Scrypt coins, not the S1 Bitcoin miner you paid for.

Your photo is now on your ticket for the team. If you still have the box, a photo of the label on it would help them trace where the mix-up happened.

Someone will get back to you by email about getting your S1 to you.
Thanks. I've shut down the miner from the GUI for now. Can I just pull out the power plug from the unit or is there a switch on the board
Used route to tech
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)

Back with you on the order side. Thanks for the label photo. It reads "Nexus L1" with an EU plug, so it matches the unit. You ordered a Nexus S1 with a UK plug, so both the model and the plug are wrong.

Both photos are on your ticket now. That's everything the team needs to trace the mix-up and sort out your S1. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden)

Keep the L1 and all its packaging together until you hear from them.
Do you have a reference number or ticket number I can have if I need to chase/follow this up

Your order number, Shop····, is the reference. Everything about this mix-up is filed under it.

A copy of this whole conversation, photos included, will come to (email hidden) once we're done here. If you need to follow up, just reply to that email or open this chat again and give the order number. Your ticket, both photos and the details will be right there.
Ok, thanks for actioning this. When can I expect a reply or update..? Im rather disappointed with this mixup

I understand, and I'm sorry. You paid for an S1 and opened an L1, and that's on us.

The team is in today, and they usually reply within one business day. The answer will come to (email hidden), so you don't need to stay in the chat. Your ticket is under Shop···· with both photos, so you won't need to explain any of it again.
